subject: SecureBridge partner ops & evidence-exchange onboarding
messages:
From: Rachel Morgan <rmorgan@auditlane.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: partners@auditlane.com
Date: 2027-04-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Intro + SecureBridge connector pilot scope

Hi Laura and team,

Thanks for the quick chat earlier. AuditLane is excited to pilot a bidirectional evidence exchange with SecureBridge so our mutual customers can push scoped SOC2 artifacts into your evidence staging area and have the transfer confirmed automatically.

High-level asks from our side:
- Simple S3-like push and limited pull for audit windows (1–3 days)
- Evidence metadata mapping (control ID, artifact type, timestamp)
- Auth: short-lived tokens + mutual TLS for the connector

Attached is our onboarding questionnaire and a draft list of required metadata fields. Can you confirm which Redwood team owns the connector ops and who we should loop in for credential provisioning and security review?

Next steps we propose: quick scoping call on Mon, 4/5 and then you send the SOW. We can fast-track DocuSign once legal signs off.

Cheers,
Rachel Morgan
Head of Integrations, AuditLane
rmorgan@auditlane.com
+1 415 555 0192

Attachments: AuditLane_Onboarding_Questionnaire.xlsx
From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Morgan <rmorgan@auditlane.com>
Cc: sergio_alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>, tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-02T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + SecureBridge connector pilot scope

Rachel — thanks for the note and the questionnaire. Appreciate the clear scope.

Quick answers:
- Connector ops owner: Sergio Alvarez (cc'd) will own runtime, and Tessa Morgan will take the onboarding/security checklist and coordinate pen-test scheduling.
- We support both push and short-lived pull flows; will want to confirm retention policy per customer.
- Auth approach sounds fine; we prefer short-lived OIDC-issued client credentials + mTLS for the pump side.

Action items I can take now:
1) Review the questionnaire and return a filled-in section for runtime requirements (ETA 4/4).
2) Draft a lightweight SOW for pilot (we'll aim to share 4/6).
3) Setup a shared Drive folder and HubSpot deal record — will send links.

Mon 4/5 10:00am PT works for a scoping call — invite to follow.

—Laura
Laura Bennett
Director, Partnerships & Alliances | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com

From: sergio_alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Morgan <rmorgan@auditlane.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-05T10:01:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + SecureBridge connector pilot scope — follow-up and infra notes

Thanks for the call this morning. Recap and infra notes for the engineering/infosec teams: 

Recap (short):
- Pilot: AuditLane -> SecureBridge (push) + scheduled pull for audit windows.
- Metadata: we will map AuditLane control_id -> Redwood control_key and preserve original timestamps.
- Retention: default staging retention 30 days; per-customer retention can be configured in the tenant settings.

Infra/ops requirements we discussed: 
- Provision a partner service account in our projects; AuditLane to provide an OAuth client_id, and we'll issue an internal service role with scoped permissions.
- Mutual TLS: AuditLane to share cert PEM via secure upload; Redwood will provide a fingerprint to bind.
- Audit logs: connector will emit operation-level events into our centralized tracing with a partner tag (partner:AuditLane).

I attached the draft SOW we pulled together after the call. Please review and comment; Tessa will follow up on security questionnaire items we still need.

Sergio Alvarez
Senior Director, Production Ops | Redwood Inference
sergio_alvarez@redwood.com

Attachments: SOW_SecureBridge_v1.2.pdf
From: Rachel Morgan <rmorgan@auditlane.com>
To: sergio_alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: partners@auditlane.com
Date: 2027-04-08T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + SecureBridge connector pilot scope — SOW review + DocuSign

Sergio / Laura — thanks for the SOW. A couple of small asks from legal/security:
1) Add a short SLA paragraph for evidence delivery acknowledgement within 5 minutes on success and a retry window for failures.
2) Clarify that AuditLane will keep a read-only copy of transferred artifacts for 14 days for their own auditability (this does not influence customer-controlled retention).

I've attached markups; Legal will route the DocuSign link once redlines are accepted.

Also — we'll upload the certificate and the filled questionnaire to the secure folder you create. Can you send the upload URL and the HubSpot deal link?

—Rachel
From: tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Morgan <rmorgan@auditlane.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, sergio_alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>, soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-11T15:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + SecureBridge connector pilot scope — final prep and access instructions

Rachel — thanks for the markups, they look reasonable. Quick update and logistics: 

1) SOW: updated SLA paragraph and retention language included; DocuSign envelope created (link below). Please sign and return so Legal can countersign.
DocuSign: https://na1-docusign.com/embedded/1234abcd-sow

2) Upload link and temp creds (expires in 72h): https://redwooddrive.company.com/shared/SecureBridge/AL-integration-specs
Credentials: user=al_integration_upload@auditlane.com, token=TEMP-UPLOAD-72H

3) Certificate instructions: attach PEM to the upload location and email me the fingerprint. We'll bind it to the gateway once verified. See attached guide (securebridge-conn-instructions.txt).

4) Next dates: connector dev window 4/12–4/22, internal pen-test scheduled 4/25–4/26. Please confirm availability for the 4/12 dev kick and whether you want us to spin up a tenant for early smoke tests.

Soojin is copied for security review; she'll chase the remaining questionnaire items that require infra input.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this live.

—Tessa Morgan
Manager, Partner Security Operations | Redwood Inference
